input.short_description: Create and list transform steps that reshape, filter, and enrich events as they flow through a pipeline via the v2 REST API.
input.body:
Transforms endpoint {{ds:component/chip|label=v2|variant=primary}}

Manage transform steps that reshape, filter, and enrich events as they pass through a pipeline. Base URL: https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v2.

Create a transform step

POST /v2/transforms

{{ds:component/parameter-table|rows_html=pipeline_idstringYesID of the pipeline this transform will be part of.namestringYesHuman-readable transform name, unique within the pipeline.typestringYesTransform type: filter, map, enrich, or flatten.configobjectYesType-specific configuration details, e.g. filter conditions or mapping rules.positionintegerNoPosition in the pipeline's transform chain (0-indexed). Defaults to appending at the end.}} {{ds:component/code-block|filename=create-transform.sh|language=bash|code=curl -X POST https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v2/transforms \\\n -H "Authorization: Bearer $GODZILLA_API_KEY" \\\n -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\\n -d '{\n "pipeline_id": "pipe_orders_to_dw",\n "name": "normalize-currency",\n "type": "map",\n "config": { "rules": [ { "field": "amount", "operation": "convert_currency" } ] }\n }'}}

List transforms

GET /v2/pipelines/{pipeline_id}/transforms — cursor-paginated, see Rate limits & errors for the pagination envelope.

Returns an ordered array of transform steps for a pipeline in their execution sequence.

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=list-transforms.sh|language=bash|code=curl -X GET https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v2/pipelines/pipe_orders_to_dw/transforms \\\n -H "Authorization: Bearer $GODZILLA_API_KEY"}}

Update a transform step

PATCH /v2/transforms/{id} — modify the configuration of an existing transform without reordering.

Only the config field may be updated. To reorder transforms within a pipeline, delete and recreate them at the desired position.

Delete a transform step

Manage transform steps that reshape, filter, and enrich events as they pass through a pipeline. Base URL: https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v2.

Create a transform step

POST /v2/transforms

{{ds:component/parameter-table|rows_html=pipeline_idstringYesID of the pipeline this transform will be part of.namestringYesHuman-readable transform name, unique within the pipeline.typestringYesTransform type: filter, map, enrich, or flatten.configobjectYesType-specific configuration details, e.g. filter conditions or mapping rules.positionintegerNoPosition in the pipeline's transform chain (0-indexed). Defaults to appending at the end.}} {{ds:component/code-block|filename=create-transform.sh|language=bash|code=curl -X POST https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v2/transforms \\\n -H "Authorization: Bearer $GODZILLA_API_KEY" \\\n -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\\n -d '{\n "pipeline_id": "pipe_orders_to_dw",\n "name": "normalize-currency",\n "type": "map",\n "config": { "rules": [ { "field": "amount", "operation": "convert_currency" } ] }\n }'}}

List transforms

GET /v2/pipelines/{pipeline_id}/transforms — cursor-paginated, see Rate limits & errors for the pagination envelope.

Returns an ordered array of transform steps for a pipeline in their execution sequence.

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=list-transforms.sh|language=bash|code=curl -X GET https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v2/pipelines/pipe_orders_to_dw/transforms \\\n -H "Authorization: Bearer $GODZILLA_API_KEY"}}
